# 2 bed detached house for sale

> Excellent Two Bedroomed Detached Residence For Sale by Private Treaty. We are excited to bring this beautifully presented residence to the market. A two bedroomed residence located in the village and within a short walk of the School, The Mill Cafe and the Church. This is an ideal location to enjoy the peaceful surrounds of this attractive area.
